name: stationinfo-no-weather-device
description: HAZARD: a portal website has no device_id, so weather_device AND about_text are both omitted. iOS StationInfo.weatherDevice is a non-optional Int.
provenance: derived from the SQLite configuration database only

deviation.reason: DEV-10 (docs/reconciliation.md O-5, option (b), the owner's answer): `about_text` and `weather_device` lose their `omitempty`. The iOS client declares both properties NON-OPTIONAL, so Go omitting either makes JSONDecoder throw keyNotFound and fail the decode of the WHOLE StationInfo object -- losing the station list, the snow device, the air-quality device and the radar token. Any portal website is permanently in that state. The Go server's response is above; this is the Rust target's, and the runner applies it only when the deviation is enabled, so the same fixture holds both halves and the Go-target replay keeps asserting what shipped.
